title: 12 Best Fine Dining in Accra
description: Discover Accra's top fine dining restaurants for 2026. From Japanese fusion to modern Ghanaian, explore the city's most exquisite culinary experiences, upscale ambiance, and insider tips.

places.name: Santoku
places.priceRange: GHS 800 - GHS 1500 (approx. $55 - $100) per person for a full meal
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The Black Cod with Miso or any of their signature sushi rolls like the Spicy Tuna.

places.name: Urban Grill
places.priceRange: GHS 900 - GHS 1800 (approx. $60 - $125) per person for a full meal
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their signature dry-aged Wagyu steak or the Grilled Lobster with garlic butter.

places.name: La Chaumiere
places.priceRange: GHS 700 - GHS 1200 (approx. $50 - $80) per person for a full meal
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The Steak Frites or the Duck Confit are consistently excellent choices.

places.name: Bôndai
places.priceRange: GHS 600 - GHS 1100 (approx. $40 - $75) per person for a full meal
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any of their signature curries or the Pad Thai, which comes highly recommended by regulars.

places.name: Bistro 22
places.priceRange: GHS 500 - GHS 1000 (approx. $35 - $70) per person for a full meal
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their Seafood Linguine or the Pan-Seared Salmon are highly praised dishes.

places.name: Heritage Restaurant
places.priceRange: GHS 550 - GHS 1000 (approx. $38 - $70) per person for a full meal
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Chef's Special' Jollof Rice with grilled fish or their Tilapia dishes.

places.name: Tamarind
places.priceRange: GHS 700 - GHS 1300 (approx. $50 - $90) per person for a full meal
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their Butter Chicken is a crowd-pleaser, or try one of their aromatic Thai curries.

places.name: La Piazza
places.priceRange: GHS 500 - GHS 900 (approx. $35 - $60) per person for a full meal
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any of their wood-fired pizzas, or the classic Lasagna al Forno.

places.name: The Neem Grill
places.priceRange: GHS 650 - GHS 1200 (approx. $45 - $80) per person for a full meal
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their Grilled Lamb Chops or the Catch of the Day, always fresh and expertly prepared.

places.name: Skybar 25
places.priceRange: GHS 700 - GHS 1300 (approx. $50 - $90) per person for a full meal
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their expertly crafted cocktails and a selection of their gourmet small plates, perfect for sharing.

places.name: Shaka Zulu
places.priceRange: GHS 600 - GHS 1100 (approx. $40 - $75) per person for a full meal
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Inquire about their chef's specials, which often feature innovative takes on regional African dishes.

places.name: Polo Beach Club Restaurant
places.priceRange: GHS 700 - GHS 1400 (approx. $50 - $95) per person for a full meal
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their fresh catch of the day, expertly grilled, or the seafood platter for a lavish treat.
